name: manual_7016b3
claim: Give every attempt a stable identifier created durably before its first external call, so lost-response, timeout and crash outcomes stay nameable and an identical retry can be recognized even when no server-side id exists yet.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: a first permit request had no permit_id to attest or retry with; a durable attempt_id reused by the finalization request gave every ambiguous outcome a name.

rationale: 2026-10-19: a first permit request had no permit_id to attest or retry with; a durable attempt_id reused by the finalization request gave every ambiguous outcome a name.
